notes: All numbers from the RETSCH MM 500 control product page Technical Data (snapshot research/v5/cache/0e554a018b650808.txt). Mill alone: 690 x 375 x 585 mm, ~63 kg, 750 W; cryoPad base unit: 670 x 110 x 590 mm, ~26 kg, 24 V 1 A, LED status light, RS-232 link. Stacked height 485 mm. Thermal plates settable 0 to -100 C in 10 C steps (PID) with LN2 at 1.2-1.4 bar; LN2 itself -196 C. Jar materials: hardened steel, stainless steel, tungsten carbide, zirconium oxide; jar sizes 10/25/50/80/125 ml. Jar outer dimensions are not published on this page, so jar geometry must come from the 125 ml volume only. The wiring entry 'none' records that there are no sample electrical connections; the cryoPad-to-mill RS-232 cable and LN2 tubing set are the only connections.
